Plants of the World Online account: Pentanema montanum (L.) D.Gut.Larr., Santos-Vicente, Anderb., E.Rico & M.M.Mart.Ort..

The native range of this species is Switzerland to W. & Central Medit. It is a perennial or rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.
